newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil still preparing CVRD court case.
newsitem.headline: Brazil still preparing CVRD court case.

text.p: Lawyers for the Brazilian government are still preparing documentation requested by a judge considering a key appeal over the sale of miner Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD), a spokeswoman said.
The spokeswoman for the Federal Advocacy said lawyers should hand in the paper work to the court Monday, but it was unclear at what time the material would be ready.

The government had been expected to hand in the documents Friday evening, but lawyers arrived 20 minutes after the Superior Court of Justice (STJ) closed and Justice Democrito Reinaldo refused to accept the papers.
"In a way it's turned out for the best because our lawyers could continue working on the documents all weekend and prepare the case," the spokeswoman said.
The auction of CVRD, originally scheduled for April 29, has been repeatedly put on hold because of court injunctions.
Justice Reinaldo was due to judge a government petition that all the injunctions be ruled on by a single tribunal because of a "conflict of interpretation" in lower courts.
The latest scheduled start for the auction was 1000 local time/0900 EDT/1300 GMT today, but a Planning Ministry spokeswoman said the sale was unlikely to take place.
"I don't think anything has changed," she said.
A spokeswoman for the National Development Bank (BNDES), which runs Brazil's privatization program, declined to say whether the auction would be officially delayed again.
"Who knows," she said. "Maybe the judge will rule today?"
